purpose: Read-only training-window value/target consistency diagnostic. No optimizer, checkpoint selection or new training experiment.
window_rule: For each fixed symbol use last513 rows of its unique training episode ending at fixed common cutoff. No outcome ranking.
sampling_seed_rule: 1911+fixed panel index, reset per phase/symbol; same underlying Gaussian draws, different policy-conditioned paths.
policy_sampling: Native stochastic Gaussian, raw actions/log-probability from policy.forward; clip each component to [-1,1] exactly as installed RecurrentPPO collector.
recurrent_state: Carry actor and critic hidden/cell states within window; reset both per symbol. Cross-check forward value against independent predict_values from same previous critic state.
targets: Backward discounted observed rewards with zero tail and critic-bootstrapped tail, plus SB3-equivalent lambda returns. Time-limit cutoffs keep marked equity and bootstrap; true insolvency termination has zero tail.
limitations: One seeded stochastic path per phase/symbol, correlated overlapping returns, finite/censored horizons and self-predicted bootstrap. Descriptive consistency only, not unbiased value calibration, true expected-return accuracy, causal optimizer diagnosis or model promotion.
frozen_integrity: Actual learned tensor/Adam records unchanged, normalization/data/source hashes unchanged; restore caller Torch/NumPy/Python RNG. No .learn or optimizer steps.
family_constraints: All failed research families remain closed; this diagnostic authorizes no rescue grid or new model.
reward_precision: Float32 rewards as SB3 VecEnv collection; targets independently accumulated in float64.
